trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.nationality <> 'German' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 0 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <> 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0 RETURN DISTINCT p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality <> 'German' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) > 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0 RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality <> 'German' AND p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL AND p.olympic_gold_medals <> '0' AND p.mvp_awards = '0' RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE p.nationality IS NOT NULL AND p.nationality <> 'German' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS DOUBLE) > 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS DOUBLE) = 0 AND r.tenure = 'latest' RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
